newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Groton, Conn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Groton, Conn..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Town of Groton, Connecticut, at Day, Berry, & Howard, CityPlace, 25th Floor, Noah Webster Conference Room, Hartford, Connecticut 06103- 3499, until 11:30 A.M. (Eastern Daylight Time) on

for the purchase when issued, at not less than par and accrued interest from the date of the Bonds to the date of delivery, of the whole of $3,720,00.00 General Obligation Bonds, Issue of 1996, payable on October 15 in each year as follows: $250,000 in each of the years 1997 through 2009 and $235,000, in each of the years 2010 through 2011. Bonds maturing after October 15, 2005 are subject to redemption prior to maturity, at the option of the Town, on or after October 15, 2005. The Bonds will be qualified tax-exempt obligations'', will be certified by First Union Bank of Connecticut, Hartford, Connecticut, and delivered against payment in Federal funds in New York, New York, on or about October 15, 1996, subject to the approving opinion of Day, Berry & Howard of Hartford, Connecticut. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, acting as securities depository. Notices of Sale, Bid Forms and the Town's Official Statement may be obtained from Ms. Janette J. Marcoux, at Independent Bond and Investment Consultants, 273 Battle Street, Bristol, Connecticut (telephone: 860-583-5133.)
